answer: Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The island panel is drawn blind, the haven escrow settles at close, and voyage lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 15% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 87 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
